name: Code Agent
description: Launch and manage Claude Code or Codex as background coding sessions. Orchestrate autonomous coding work with plan approval, worktree isolation, and lifecycle management.

claudePath.description: Path to Claude Code CLI binary. Default: "claude" (from PATH).

codexPath.description: Path to Codex CLI binary. Default: "codex" (from PATH).

defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Default session timeout in seconds. Default: 1800 (30 min).
